mainEntity.name: Is it really one flat rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Your move is quoted as one flat price, agreed in writing before move day — we do not bill by the hour. Our guarantee: Guaranteed Flat Rate or Your Move is Free!

Assets of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs — safes, medical devices, cryogenic equipment, pianos and antiques — are planned under SIR and the KIM-GS Protocol, with a floor-deflection check to L/360 before anything lifts.

The International Standards for Phytosanitary Measures No. 15 — the global rule for wood packaging in export. Our export crates are built from compliant, treated, marked wood so shipments clear customs.

From two home bases — Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — across the Shenandoah Valley and Eastern Panhandle, with 16 published service areas from Winchester and 14 from Martinsburg, plus long-distance runs on I-81, I-66 and I-70. Full list on our Service Areas page.

Winchester (The Flat Rate Movers): Mon–Fri 8am–6pm, Sat 8am–4pm, Sun 9am–4pm. Martinsburg (Flat Rate Movers Martinsburg WV): Mon–Fri 9am–6pm, Sat 9am–4pm, Sun 9am–4pm. Phone +1-540-422-2153, email ratemovers@gmail.com.
Short (Quick Quote) is the default and is enough for most moves. Toggle Detailed on the quote button itself when your project needs full detail — nothing you typed is lost when you switch.
Yes — full, partial and fragile-only packing and unpacking, custom crates, ISPM 15 export packing, loading, transloading and final-mile delivery.

mainEntity.name: Do you move offices and industrial sites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — office moving, industrial offices, commercial, government and military relocations, planned around your operation and quoted flat in writing.

mainEntity.name: How are you rated on Google?

acceptedAnswer.text: Winchester: 5.0 from 1 review. Martinsburg: 4.7 from 6 reviews — listed per branch, never blended. Many high-value clients choose not to review, which we respect.

mainEntity.name: Is the price really flat, even for a short local move?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Flat Rate Movers price by the job, not by the hour — the rate is agreed in writing before move day, and the tagline is the guarantee: Guaranteed Flat Rate or Your Move is Free!

Both bases dispatch across the region. Winchester serves the Shenandoah Valley side and Martinsburg serves the Eastern Panhandle side, and the service areas overlap at Moorefield — the quote form settles which crew and route fit your move.

mainEntity.name: What if my move includes a gun safe, piano or medical device?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-mass assets of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs move under SIR and the KIM-GS Protocol, with floor-deflection analysis to L/360 — the same standard as our dedicated heavy-asset work, applied inside a local or regional move.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from a standard office move?

acceptedAnswer.text: The setting. A standard office move is a commercial office; an industrial offices move is the office area inside a plant, warehouse or industrial facility — same flat-rate standard, planned for the site it sits in.

mainEntity.name: What about heavy equipment in the office area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Any item of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs moves under SIR Structural Integrity Relocation and the KIM-GS Protocol, with floor-deflection analysis to L/360, before anything is lifted.
